units.source_text: 而且，我自己也想要写一写的，即便没有义务这一说，我也想写写自己的过去。

en.t: Moreover, I myself want to write about it; even if there were no question of duty, I would still want to write about my own past.

units.source_text: 我的过去只是我个人的经历，所以也不妨说是属于我个人的，

en.t: My past is only my own personal experience, so one may well say that it belongs to me alone,

units.source_text: 若不把它讲述给别人知道，就去死的话，别人会说很可惜吧。

en.t: and if I were to die without telling it to anyone, people would probably say it was a pity.

units.source_text: 我多少也有这样的想法。

en.t: I do have something of that feeling myself.

units.source_text: 只是我想，与其告诉那些不能理解我的人，

en.t: But I think that rather than tell it to people who cannot understand me,

units.source_text: 还不如干脆把它同我的生命一起埋葬掉的好。

en.t: it would be better simply to bury it together with my life.

units.source_text: 说真的，如果现在我不认识你这样一个人，

en.t: To tell the truth, if I did not now know someone like you,

units.source_text: 我的过去便终归只是我的过去，连间接地成为别人的借鉴也是不可能的。

en.t: my past would remain only my past to the end, and it would not even be possible for it to serve indirectly as a lesson to anyone else.

units.source_text: 在几千万日本人中，我只想对你讲出我的过去，

en.t: Among the tens of millions of Japanese people, you are the only one to whom I want to tell my past,

units.source_text: 因为你是认真的，

en.t: because you are earnest,

units.source_text: 因为你说过：‘要认真获得人生中的活生生的教训。’

en.t: because you once said, "I want earnestly to gain living lessons from life itself."

units.source_text: 我要将黑暗的人世间的阴影无所顾忌地抛到你的头上，

en.t: I will cast the shadow of the dark human world over your head without holding anything back,

units.source_text: 但是，你不要害怕。

en.t: but you must not be afraid.

units.source_text: 你凝视着那阴暗的东西，从中选择你可以借鉴的东西。

en.t: Look steadily at that darkness, and choose from it whatever you can take as a lesson.

units.source_text: 我所说的阴暗的东西，当然是伦理道德层面上的。

en.t: The darkness I speak of is, of course, darkness on the level of ethics and morality.

units.source_text: 我是被旧的伦理道德孕育、熏陶而长大成人的，

en.t: I was born into the old ethics and morals, nurtured by them, and brought up under their influence,

units.source_text: 这种伦理道德上的思维，或许与当今年轻人的理念大相径庭，

en.t: and this way of thinking about ethics and morality may differ greatly from the ideas of young people today,

units.source_text: 但无论怎样不同，却是我自身之物，

en.t: but however different it may be, it is my own,

units.source_text: 它不是花钱租来的衣裳。

en.t: not a garment rented for money.

units.source_text: 因此我想，对于今后想出人头地的你来说，

en.t: For that reason, I think that for you, who hope to make your way in the world from now on,

units.source_text: 多少会有参考价值的吧。

en.t: it will probably have at least some value as a reference.
